info.title: IonoFlux API
info.description: Public OpenAPI subset captured 2026-10-20; no authenticated responses.

get.description: One-call snapshot of the latest solar, geomagnetic and ionospheric indicators with data freshness.

NOAA SWPC alerts, watches, warnings and summaries (geomagnetic storms, radio blackouts, proton events),
plus IonoFlux-detected Sporadic-E openings (`ES_OPENING`, source `ionoflux`).

parameters.name: since

schema.description: Only alerts issued after this time. Default: last 7 days.
schema.title: Since

parameters.description: Only alerts issued after this time. Default: last 7 days.

get.description:
Current NOAA Radio blackout (R), Solar radiation storm (S) and Geomagnetic storm (G) levels,
the 24-hour maximum, and probabilities for the next three days.

schema.title: Response Scales V1 Alerts Scales Get

get.description: Upstream providers, licenses, and the health of each collector (last success, failures, staleness).

Per dataset: records held (approximate for large tables), records in the last 24 hours, time coverage,
retention and collector freshness, plus the Parquet archive of raw reception reports. Cached for two minutes.

schema.title: Response Data Status Summary V1 Data Status Get

get.description: The most recent records of one dataset as stored (reference tables: the largest entries).

schema.title: Response Data Status Detail V1 Data Status  Dataset  Get

get.description:
10.7 cm solar radio flux in solar flux units (sfu), measured at Penticton up to three times per day.
The 20:00 UTC (“Noon”) value is the official daily index.
